Color of the icons and labels in the top bar of Home: bell, Bluetooth, network, USB, settings, date, time and the buttons on the left (except the application icon itself). Auto: follows the theme and background, as before. White and black: the buttons or the ends of the bar; any color: the bar (remote: left and right move the slider in even steps, OK: Auto or white). The dim state (Bluetooth off, USB without a drive) is shown in the same color, paler; the number in the bell turns black or white by itself. Applies at once.
